description: This Java class, DOMSettingsBuilder, is responsible for serializing application settings into an XML file. It constructs various XML nodes representing different configuration aspects such as window layout, file directories, options, display settings, logger configuration, clipboard formats, and icons, then serializes the constructed XML structure to an output file.

classes.name: DOMSettingsBuilder
classes.description: A utility class responsible for building and serializing application settings into an XML configuration file.

methods.name: buildSettings
methods.description: Constructs an XML document representing various application settings and writes it to the specified output file, updating progress along the way.

methods.name: buildWindow
methods.description: Creates an XML node encapsulating window layout settings such as size, position, and maximized state.

methods.name: buildFiles
methods.description: Creates an XML node representing file directory settings, including image directory, repository, and ECU definition files.

methods.name: buildOptions
methods.description: Builds an XML node detailing various user options and configuration flags, including version info.

methods.name: buildTableDisplay
methods.description: Creates an XML node containing table display preferences, fonts, cell sizes, and color settings.

methods.name: buildLogger
methods.description: Constructs an XML node capturing logger configurations, including window layout, protocol, ports, and profiles.

methods.name: buildTableClipboardFormat
methods.description: Builds an XML node defining clipboard table formats and headers.

methods.name: buildIcons
methods.description: Creates an XML node with icon scaling and display preferences.
